The previous body (🟢 `marchtian`, seated 2026-10-29) is the prior revision of this body; its 收班简报 is the comment posted right after this edit.

## Current PM

⏳ vacant since 2026-10-29T21:55Z. Predecessor: `marchtian` · `session_017ihL2dPRZXfgE1A2Vct3FU` (a thread of the Claude Code project "Objectstack 本体 skills"), clocked out on the maintainer's words 「skills 当前任务处理完，合并后就下班」 (2026-10-29). No stay-behind: no open PR and no claimed card of this seat.

- Seat 2 (`domain:skills#2`, #19287) is 🟢 `os-elon-musk` at this edit and reads the whole lane queue while seat 1 is empty.
